In 5 years, a mistake as simple as accidentally deleting one wrong paragraph while editing a paper could have easily dinged her GPA, but instead turned my friend Hannah from casual into a perfectionism.

The semester started off like so, a flurry as always to find all my books on reserve in time to read them, the endless cups poured to help stay up until midnight before the exam due next class, my friend Hannah's paper in hand, ready at midnight.

"Here you go. Just a rough, rough outline. No way you should use it verboteen for your paper." she joked, a wry half smirk.

"Sounds great." But as always my brain just didn'T turn it all off at night and she knew it so instead, the very late hours began to blur into the same sleep deprived days that had defined my undergrad
